headline: UK Business Leaders Urge Easing of Post-Brexit Cross-Channel Travel Rules
summary: The Confederation of British Industry and business leaders called on the UK and European Commission to urgently ease post-Brexit business travel rules, warning that current restrictions harm cross-Channel investment and trade.
why: Cross-border mobility and administrative friction between the UK and the European Union are key determinants of trade flows, professional services revenue, and foreign direct investment.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: UK-EU cross-border business travel restrictions are cited by business groups as a barrier to trade and investment.
